deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :shadow, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

src/multiformats/cid_hash.kotoba.reason: AWAI-531: preserve byte CID API via pure byte-only owner, separating dormant text hash capabilities.

src/multiformats/sha256.kotoba.reason: AWAI-531: expose bounded streaming state using the existing SHA-256 compression implementation.

src/multiformats/byte_cid.kotoba.reason: AWAI-531: bounded pure Native byte identity/Pack closure; preserve existing corpus and APIs.
